chunks: We have indeed created all things by measure;
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about divine decree and creation?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Qamar emphasizes the concept of divine decree (Qadr), stating that Allah created everything with precise measurement and order. It serves as a foundational theological principle in Shia thought regarding the structured nature of creation, particularly highlighting the balance between divine omnipotence and the orderly governance of the universe (Nizam).
